name: registry path: renaming the plan heading while flipping is refused
description: The registry fixture holds a run bound to plan-a-step-1, imported from a session whose key is gone, so it is not eligible to hand off (the empty Galaxy fixture can't re-verify it). Deny mode. In one edit the model renames the plan heading and flips the checkbox. The legacy path loses the step (gate-scripted-legacy-heading-rename); the registry path finds anchored checkboxes anywhere in the file and refuses the flip.
